terms.useCase: Record the duration of the time window used to compute one aggregate observation value.
terms.reuseReason: dcat:temporalResolution describes dataset resolution and cannot be assumed to equal the source aggregation window.

terms.useCase: Identify the role accountable for the meaning and change control of a local SHACL constraint.
terms.reuseReason: SHACL defines constraint execution and messages but no annotation for the accountable governance role.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Publish discovery metadata about a dataset that may later become a dataspace offering without asserting that a DSP Offer or Agreement exists.
terms.reuseReason: DCAT Resource describes catalogue resources, while DSP Offer is an operational protocol object. Neither carries the deliberately non-operational readiness and qualification-evidence boundary required here.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Link a non-operational offering-metadata record to the dataset it describes for discovery.
terms.reuseReason: dcat:dataset is a catalogue membership relation and DSP relations concern operational offers; neither states this one-to-one discovery projection without changing its meaning.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Name the DQV metric selected as the target of one reviewed source-quality mapping.
terms.reuseReason: dqv:isMeasurementOf links a measurement to a metric, not a mapping statement to the metric chosen during semantic transformation.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: State whether absent observations are preserved, coded, excluded from aggregation or imputed.
terms.reuseReason: No DCAT or SOSA catalogue-level property records the transformation policy for missing values on an ObservationDataset.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Name the agent that governs the uniqueness scope of a network identifier and edition.
terms.reuseReason: dct:publisher describes publication responsibility and cannot safely be reused as the issuing authority for network identifier resolution.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Identify catalogue datasets whose records depend on a versioned road, rail, stop, node or link network.
terms.reuseReason: DCAT Dataset and the spatial profiles do not distinguish datasets whose identifiers must be resolved against one governed network edition.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: List the node, link, section, stop or facility types covered by a network reference.
terms.reuseReason: dct:type on the reference would not distinguish the type of referenced network elements from the type of the reference resource itself.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Record the authority-scoped identifier of a transport network or network identifier system.
terms.reuseReason: dct:identifier identifies the NetworkReference resource itself and cannot separately identify the governed network within its issuing authority.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Distinguish candidate, current, superseded and withdrawn network editions during identifier resolution.
terms.reuseReason: Generic ADMS status values do not encode the local network-edition lifecycle used by the join and publication controls.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Connect a NetworkDataset to the authority-and-edition record used to interpret its network identifiers.
terms.reuseReason: dct:references is too weak to require the NetworkReference identity tuple and would not activate the local integrity constraints.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Resolve network element identifiers against one authority, network identifier, edition, validity interval, checksum and lifecycle record.
terms.reuseReason: No reused DCAT, PROV or GeoDCAT-AP class packages the authority and edition identity needed to prevent cross-edition joins.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Bind a network edition to the SHA-256 digest of its fixed distribution or approved manifest.
terms.reuseReason: SPDX checksum objects describe files, while this property binds the edition identity tuple directly to the selected snapshot digest under a fixed algorithm policy.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Record the first date on which a network edition may be used for identifier resolution and joins.
terms.reuseReason: dct:valid does not separate the start and end values needed for SHACL Core cardinality and ordering checks on a NetworkReference.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Record the last date on which a network edition is interpreted as current, while allowing an open-ended current edition.
terms.reuseReason: dct:valid does not expose the optional end date as a separately constrained value for network-edition resolution.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Record the authority-issued edition or snapshot identifier of the governed network state.
terms.reuseReason: owl:versionInfo and dct:hasVersion concern resource versions generally and would blur the network edition inside the authority-scoped identity tuple.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Declare whether source observations are instantaneous, summed, averaged, minimum, maximum or median values.
terms.reuseReason: SOSA and DCAT do not provide a dataset-level controlled property for the aggregation operator used in a published observation series.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Describe dataset-level traffic observations with subject, observed property, aggregation window, missing-value handling and value unit.
terms.reuseReason: SOSA Observation and ObservationCollection represent observations, not a catalogue Dataset summary. Declaring equivalence would change the level of description.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Declare whether observation values concern a site, section, network element, facility, vehicle population or area.
terms.reuseReason: SOSA feature-of-interest links individual observations to subjects; it does not provide this catalogue-level subject-type summary.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Name the QUDT unit needed to interpret values in an observation dataset independently of quality-measurement units.
terms.reuseReason: QUDT defines Unit resources but not a DCAT Dataset property for the unit of the observation payload represented by the dataset.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Name the phenomenon or characteristic represented by values in an observation dataset.
terms.reuseReason: sosa:observedProperty applies to SOSA observations. Reusing it directly on dcat:Dataset would imply a modelling level that this catalogue profile does not claim.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Track description, external qualification, suspension or withdrawal of a candidate offering without claiming operational readiness.
terms.reuseReason: DSP has operational offer states and ADMS has general asset states; neither expresses this deliberately non-operational catalogue review workflow.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Reference evidence used outside the public graph to review authority, delegation, validity or connector readiness.
terms.reuseReason: PROV can type the evidence entity but does not supply a catalogue relation whose presence is explicitly non-conclusive for operational qualification.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Classify the method used to produce a quality measurement while leaving algorithm details in a versioned method document.
terms.reuseReason: DQV does not define a controlled evaluation-method relation for QualityMeasurement, and prov:wasGeneratedBy would identify an activity rather than the reviewed method class.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Describe the evaluated population, sample, attributes or period so a measurement is not mistaken for a whole-dataset result.
terms.reuseReason: DQV computedOn identifies the dataset but has no field for the actual subset or sampling scope evaluated by a measurement.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: State whether a source-to-DQV mapping is lossless, reversibly lossy, irreversibly lossy, unmapped or withheld.
terms.reuseReason: DQV has no property for transformation loss or publication exclusion on a source-quality mapping statement.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Explain source semantics not preserved by a non-lossless, unmapped or unpublished quality mapping and any reverse conditions.
terms.reuseReason: SKOS notes and SHACL messages do not belong to the mapping instance and cannot carry the reviewed loss explanation needed by the ledger.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Connect each DQV measurement to the source-element mapping and loss ledger that explains its projection.
terms.reuseReason: dqv:isMeasurementOf identifies only the target metric and cannot retain source-element identity or mapping loss.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Record how a source quality element maps to DQV, including loss disposition and the information needed for reverse review.
terms.reuseReason: DQV supplies metrics and measurements but has no statement type for source-element mapping loss, non-publication or reverse-mapping notes.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Link a categorical DQV measurement to the controlled concept represented by its literal code.
terms.reuseReason: DQV defines dqv:value as a datatype property and has no property that links a categorical measurement value to a SKOS concept.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.reuseReason: DQV permits a value but does not provide a result-kind discriminator that closes datatype and unit semantics for this profile.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Distinguish unassessed, assessed, warning, failed and stale dataset quality states without treating missing measurements as a pass.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Attach operational correction guidance to a governed constraint independently of its diagnostic message.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Link one SHACL constraint to its requirement register row and conformance fixtures with a stable identifier.
terms.reuseReason: SHACL blank-node identity and source locations are not stable cross-artifact identifiers, and no standard SHACL predicate provides this traceability key.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Identify the source-standard or source-system quality element used as input to a DQV mapping.
terms.reuseReason: DQV identifies target metrics and measurements but does not identify the source semantic element preserved in a crosswalk.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

terms.useCase: Activate the local CRS, spatial disclosure and geometry publication controls for a catalogue dataset.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.

deprecation.policy: The term is not deprecated in this release; a future deprecation requires a replacement IRI and a migration policy before publication.
